text:
Sea grew its revenue faster than Grab in both FY2024 and FY2025.

- **FY2024:** Sea's revenue grew 28.8% YoY (from $13,063.6M to $16,819.9M) [Sea, FY2024, p.91], versus Grab's 18.6% YoY growth (from $2,359M to $2,797M) [Grab, FY2024, p.128].
- **FY2025:** Sea's revenue grew 36.4% YoY (from $16,819.9M to $22,938.5M) [Sea, FY2025, p.95], versus Grab's 20.5% YoY growth (from $2,797M to $3,370M) [Grab, FY2025, p.88].

In both years, Sea's year-over-year revenue growth rate (28.8% in FY2024, 36.4% in FY2025) outpaced Grab's (18.6% in FY2024, 20.5% in FY2025), and Sea's growth rate also accelerated more between the two years.
